title: Throughput threshold (public interface)
purpose: Same load as s5 (~84 Mbps of 5 MB responses through the load balancer), but the threshold watches the public interface (eth-pub) instead of the private one. Per Cycle's docs, load-balancer traffic uses eth-priv and eth-pub carries only the container's own internet traffic, so this should not scale either. If it does, the two interfaces are swapped in the threshold or in the docs.
